latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor on Android — mobile video editing and export tool.

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe your edit; get downloadable 1080p MP4 exports without complex controls.
- No app install required; all editing and rendering happens securely on remote GPU nodes.
- Supports session management, automatic token handling, and balance checking with free tier access.
- Clear error handling for common issues like file size, format, credits, or expired tokens.
- Batch, iterative, and quick-edit workflows available for mobile creators on the go.
